selected_script.angle: Absurd chef-hat husband rescues wife whose laundry room wire rack collapsed from wet jeans, wheeling in the heavy-duty double rod clothes rack.
selected_script.hook: Laundry piled high and nowhere to dry?

video_001_part_01.description: Show collapsed wire rack with wet jeans, followed by chef-uniform husband entering with the rack, assembling it using thread rolling joints, and hanging the heavy wet laundry.

video_001_part_02.description: Show the rack locked in bedroom using caster brakes, showing bottom shelf shoe storage, ending with CTA.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical UGC ad video. Timeline: 0-1.5s: Close-up of wet jeans on a collapsed, bent laundry room wire rack. No product or rescuer. 1.5-3s: Absurd husband in chef uniform and tall white chef hat enters carrying the HYSEYY Double Rods Clothes Rack (unloaded, matte black metal frame, double rods, caster wheels), places it down and says 'Let chef handle this!' 3-6s: Husband connects vertical rods using thread rolling mounting (twisting and screwing tubes together). 6-10s: Heavy wet laundry hung neatly on the high-low staggered double rods. Keep pacing fast and product-focused. Do not start with perfect product shot. Do not end with CTA. Use reference image to preserve product details: matte black 22mm steel tubing, staggered dual-bar structure.

Create a 10-second vertical UGC ad video. Timeline: 0-4s: Fast-cut scene in a bedroom. Hands press down caster brake levers on the bottom wheels to lock the rack in place. Dresses, shirts, and bags are hung on the double rods and side extension bars. 4-8s: Bottom dual-pipe storage rack holding shoe boxes and shoes. 8-10s: Short CTA on screen: 'Make your space cleaner and cozier.' This segment must continue the style of the first segment. Keep product identity consistent: matte black steel tubing, dual rods, bottom shelf. Use reference image to preserve material and structure details.
